tours.description: A friendly step-by-step guide for correcting a cash sale with "Reverse and Create Invoice". You will create and confirm the cash order, deliver the goods and invoice the customer. Then you will reverse the invoice with a credit note and, in the same action, create a fresh draft invoice that you confirm, and finally request and approve the credit note.

What you will see: a new Customer Invoice with the status Draft and a Confirm button. Watch out: use this button only when the customer still wants the goods and needs a corrected invoice. If the goods are simply returned, use Reverse instead (see the Return Cash Sales Order guide).
